Install omaspeak on Omarchy

Local-first text-to-speech application and daemon (pre-built binary)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omaspeak-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.1.0-1:
    pacman -Qi omaspeak-bin

Open and use omaspeak

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql omaspeak-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omaspeak on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omaspeak-bin. The download is 6.5 MB and it takes 16.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omaspeak free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause.

How do I uninstall omaspeak?

Run omarchy pkg drop omaspeak-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does omaspeak depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: alsa-utils, gcc-libs, glibc. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omaspeak in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omaspeak-bin (version 0.1.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. jacob-vincent-mink makes it. Project site: https://github.com/jacob-vincent-mink/omaspeak.
